judgment.reason: From p11, Ada wears a copper card (unconditional fact). From p8, if Ada wears a copper card, then Ada wears a violet hat—so Ada wears a violet hat. From p26, if Ada wears a violet hat, then Ada wears a cobalt hat—so Ada wears a cobalt hat. From p14, if Ada wears a cobalt hat, then Ada wears a scarlet scarf—so Ada wears a scarlet scarf. The query asserts the negation of this derived fact. Since the premises entail that Ada wears a scarlet scarf, the query ("it is not the case that Ada wears a scarlet scarf") is false.
